ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white/cream) pixels comprise approximately 80-85% of the visible ventral surface, contrasted with low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels primarily along the trailing edge and localized clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white background across both lobes. Continuous low-intensity black band along the trailing edge margin. High-contrast dark circular/elliptical blobs clustered on the proximal region of the left lobe. Diffuse mid-intensity ochre/yellowish patches visible across the central and right lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated internal angle of approximately 85-90 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated peaks along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged pixel-amplitude spikes at both distal tips, with the right tip displaying a more irregular, multi-pointed topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave sweep from the median notch extending towards the distal tips, terminating in convex outer lobe edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated cluster of dark, roughly circular ring-like pixel formations on the left lobe. Scattered, smaller low-intensity spots distributed across the central-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular jagged morphology and potential tissue loss at the terminal end of the right fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive ochre-colored surface staining (consistent with diatom film) across the central and right-central ventral fluke surface.
